d: Short champagne-blonde hair in a messy, layered style with choppy bangs and a small ponytail. Sharp, golden-orange eyes with a focused expression on a youthful face. A slender build, wearing a futuristic white and black bodysuit with an orange cropped jacket, black long sleeves, and heavy mechanical armor plating on the legs in white and dark grey. Signature accessories include white and gold headphones around the neck and large, floating mechanical wing-like blades behind the back.
